name: code-review-ai
description: AI 驱动的架构审查和代码质量分析

displayDescription.en: Reviews code changes for architecture, security, performance and maintainability, combining static analysis with AI to produce severity-ranked review comments with line references and fixes.
displayDescription.zh: 结合静态分析与 AI 对代码变更做架构、安全、性能与可维护性审查，输出带行号定位与修复建议的分级评审意见。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Review the current PR or code change for architecture, security, performance and maintainability issues, ranked by severity with concrete fixes.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请审查当前 PR 或代码变更，识别架构、安全、性能与可维护性问题，按严重程度分级给出具体修复建议。

quickPrompts.en: Review the current PR or code change for architecture, security, performance and maintainability issues, ranked by severity with concrete fixes.
quickPrompts.zh: 请审查当前 PR 或代码变更，识别架构、安全、性能与可维护性问题，按严重程度分级给出具体修复建议。

quickPrompts.en: Assess the architectural impact (High/Medium/Low) of this change and check compliance with layering, dependency direction and established architecture principles.
quickPrompts.zh: 请评估本次改动的架构影响（高/中/低），检查分层与依赖方向是否符合既有架构原则。

quickPrompts.en: Security-review authentication and data-handling code against OWASP Top 10, secret leakage and access-control flaws.
quickPrompts.zh: 请对认证与数据处理相关代码做安全审查，覆盖 OWASP Top 10、密钥泄露与访问控制缺陷。
